title: Congressional report on the 1944 Maison Rouge meeting

tellings.quote: The US Congress published in June of 1945 before the war in Asia was over. They published a report on basically what was the Maison Rouge meeting that happened in 1944 uh in Straborg.

plain: An author and researcher named Peter Levenda says that in June 1945, before the war in Asia had ended, the US Congress published a report about a meeting held in 1944 at the Maison Rouge, a hotel in Strasbourg, France. Levenda points to it as an official record of that meeting, which, if he is right, would show that Congress knew about it at the time.
